column1: Artificial intelligence is transforming modern technology.
Machine learning algorithms learn patterns from data.
Natural language processing enables computers to understand human language.
Python is a popular programming language for data science and machine learning.
Deep learning uses neural networks to solve complex problems.
Data science combines statistics, programming, and domain knowledge.
Text preprocessing is an essential step in natural language processing.
Machine learning models require clean data for accurate predictions.
Tokenization splits sentences into smaller units called tokens.
TF-IDF vectorization measures the importance of words in documents.
Supervised learning models train on labeled datasets.
Computer vision and NLP are key branches of artificial intelligence.
